nodes.label: Lesson Grant Tool Authorization Design
nodes.rationale: chose a worker-local tool over teaching /api/mcp to accept the grant, because MCP exists specifically to let third-party-hosted agents reach the backend, and the LiveKit worker already is backend code with its own Claude tools array — reusing MCP would reverse the 'no second way in, one header one scheme' rule from the static-token-auth doc; deferring all writes to session end was rejected because the tutor cannot truthfully report 'added' before the write lands, and a crash would silently lose saves.
